hook: Road accident? *₹1.5 lakh* free treatment, but only *469* Telangana hospitals have signed up
tldr: Under the PM Rahat scheme, road accident victims can get treatment worth up to ₹1.5 lakh. Over 1,000 hospitals are on Aarogyasri, but only 469 have enrolled in PM Rahat. Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju has told collectors to enrol all eligible hospitals.

beats.what: The Chief Secretary wants every eligible network hospital enrolled.
beats.why: The scheme could bring at least ₹100 crore a year for treatment, easing the load on Aarogyasri.
beats.care: If you or someone you see is in a crash, ask the hospital about PM Rahat. Treatment shouldn't wait for money.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Widen hospital coverage under PM Rahat: CS Jaju (print, Hyderabad edition, 26 Oct, p.4)
